settings.name: Amara O.
settings.description: Shoots the city at golden hour and packs one bag, always. Wears the Technical Traveler set from Lagos to London.

settings.name: Jonas K.
settings.description: Designs quiet buildings and takes loud trips. Six countries a year, one carry-on, zero compromises.

settings.name: Mia T.
settings.description: Collects recipes the way others collect stamps. Currently eating her way down the Pacific coast.

settings.name: Lisbon
settings.description: Hills, Atlantic light and slow mornings. The city that taught us to travel lighter.

settings.name: Kyoto
settings.description: Temples at dawn, coffee at noon, quiet by design. Go in November when the maples turn.

settings.name: Marrakech
settings.description: A city that rewards the curious. Get lost in the medina, then find yourself on a rooftop at sunset.

settings.name: Cartagena
settings.description: Color, heat and sea air. The old town asks you to slow down — listen to it.

settings.name: Casa Cielo
settings.description: A palm-shaded hideaway between jungle and sea. Pack the Staples capsule and very little else.

settings.name: Riad Amara
settings.description: Eight rooms around a courtyard pool, ten minutes from the souks and a world away from them.

settings.name: Villa Sel
settings.description: Whitewashed walls, salt on the breeze. The Aegean does the decorating.
